content: {"reasoning": "The only payer response so far was CO-97 (service bundled, not separately payable), which is a coding/bundling issue, not a medical-necessity issue — so the earlier necessity appeal did not address the actual denial. CO-97 is a contractual adjustment that cannot be billed to the patient, and there is no new denial on the table to support another appeal or a peer-to-peer. The correct progression for a bundling denial is to fix the claim (e.g., add an appropriate distinct-service modifier) and resubmit; this is permitted because the prior claim was denied, not paid, so it does not trip the CO-18 duplicate rule, and timely filing still has 88 days.", "action": "correct_and_resubmit"}
